::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 14th 1882  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 117-118
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

There is [a new volume of Cameos](cmy_books/cmybook_134.qmd) just ready to come out, ending at Queen Elizabeth’s death. I suppose it must be called ‘Wars of the Reformation’ I do not like the term Wars of Religion.

I am also finishing off [Stray Pearls](cmy_books/cmybook_170.qmd), which will be completed in the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) in June, in 32 or 33 chapters - so I suppose it may come out about that time.

It is a sort of continuation of [the Chaplet of Pearls](cmy_books/cmybook_69.qmd) in the time of  the Fronde, when the cavaliers were in exile.

Will you kindly desire a copy of [<u>Magnum Bonum</u>](cmy_books/cmybook_131.qmd) and of the [<u>Clever Woman</u>](cmy_books/cmybook_58.qmd) to be sent me

Yours very truly
C M Yonge
